verdict.rationale: dlt has a documented LanceDB destination for loading data into a vector store for similarity search (dlt-docs-9/31/56), and pipeline.dataset() exposes results as Arrow/Pandas/records queryable via SQL/Ibis for LLM-ready consumption (dlt-docs-12/28/43). An official MCP server also exposes a read-only SQL query tool against the pipeline's destination dataset, letting agents retrieve synced data directly (dlt-docs-47/72, dlt-probe-4). missing for 10: broader vector-store destination coverage beyond LanceDB (e.g. Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma), and independent/hands-on evidence of an agent actually retrieving from a vector store built by dlt
